The proof nonetheless fails at line 0687, where the complex-conjugation eigenspace in the lower bound is the wrong one: the Bloch-Kato lemma at 0676 bounds the quantity below by the dimension of the c=1 part of W_i, not by its codimension, and Lemma silly_injectivity — invoked at 0689 to make the bound positive — supplies nonvanishing precisely of the c=1 parts. As written, 0687-0689 asserts and then uses dim W_i^{c=-1} > 0 infinitely often, which neither follows from the cited lemma nor is true in general.
